errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва различни категории наети лица
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, meaning the categories are on the vertical axis, not the horizontal one.
The categories are not sorted in alphabetical order ('П', 'Т', 'С', 'У'). They are sorted by their corresponding values in ascending order from top to bottom.
The vertical axis displays the categories. The values (оценката) are represented by the length of the horizontal bars along the horizontal axis.
The value axis (horizontal) has no title. 'Технически ... равнище' is part of the text for two of the category labels on the vertical axis, not an axis title.

The description does not mention the units for the values on the horizontal axis. Although not explicitly stated on the axis itself, the prompt asks for units if available, and the provided caption states the units are '%'. The description also fails to mention that the value axis has no visible labels or tick marks.
